coverage_decision: All five main-text figures and both main-text tables were rendered and reconciled. No supplement was present in the source packet.
omissions: Reference pages 10-11 were extracted to the reference task queue but not atomized as evidence.

source_integrity_findings.finding: Figure 4 prints the EMPA-TROPISM row as 0.86 [0.78, 0.95], identical to the pooled sensitivity estimate, even though the Results text states that a formal trial HR was not estimable before continuity correction. The article does not report the continuity-corrected trial-level HR in prose.

Figure 5 prints the EMPA-TROPISM row as 0.70 [0.64, 0.77], identical to the pooled HHF sensitivity estimate. This is implausibly precise for the 84-person zero-event trial and duplicates the pooled label exactly; the source is preserved as printed.
The Discussion attributes EMPA-TROPISM remodeling, peak VO2, and NT-proBNP findings to reference 9, while the bibliography identifies EMPA-TROPISM as reference 11. The citation mismatch is retained.

The Discussion makes broad favorable safety statements from cited trials, but the Conclusions state that safety outcomes were not included in this review because reporting varied and some trials had risk-of-bias concerns. The SEA treats safety as unsynthesized background, not a meta-analytic finding.
